item.title: Ask HN: Did society luck out by forcing mathematicians to reinvent their field?
item.summary: I think it is great that mathematicians are having an existential crisis due to major recent AI breakthroughs in math research. Mathematicians are considered the smartest people and who better than the smartest people to show how reinventing their field to coexist with AI could work? What do you think?
